lines.zh: 我踩着余烬走，脚下冒火星。
lines.en: I walk on embers, sparks rising underfoot.

lines.zh: 我每一步都留下一小片焦。
lines.en: Each step leaves a small scorch.

lines.zh: 我从屋脊上走下来，很轻。
lines.en: I come down off the roof ridge, lightly.

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊走，火跟着我。
lines.en: I walk the corridor, and fire follows me.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽在身后拖着火。
lines.en: My tail feathers trail fire behind me.
I go around the wooden rail so I do not burn it.
I pace slowly toward your side.

lines.zh: 我走两步，翅膀抖起火星。
lines.en: Two steps and my wings shake out sparks.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，空气在抖。
lines.en: Where I pass, the air shimmers.
I walk step by step over the stone.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，火光跟着动。
lines.en: I turn around, and the firelight moves with me.
I look down at the fire beneath me.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀稍微张开散热。
lines.en: I open my wings a little to shed heat.

lines.zh: 我朝有干草的方向小心避开。
lines.en: I steer carefully clear of the dry hay.
My shadow carries an orange glow.
As I walk, the edges of my feathers burn.

lines.zh: 我一停，地上的火就旺了。
lines.en: When I stop, the fire on the ground grows.
I come round from behind you to your side.
I stand, my whole body a mild fire.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛边缘一直在动。
lines.en: The edges of my feathers never stop moving.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进冒火的羽里。
lines.en: I tuck my head into my burning feathers.

lines.zh: 我在等炭火里再长出来。
lines.en: I wait to rise again from the embers.
One breath of mine and the air scalds.
I shake and sparks fall.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地展开一边翅膀。
lines.en: I unfold one wing slowly.
I stand and the fire slowly dwindles.
My eyes are like two coals.

lines.zh: 我在等一盏灯被举起来。
lines.en: I wait for a lantern to be raised.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在焦石上磨了磨。
lines.en: I scrape my claws on the scorched stone.

lines.zh: 我身上的火从来没灭过。
lines.en: The fire on me has never gone out.
You hold up a lamp; good fire.
I know the heat in your hands.
You are standing inside my ring of fire.
Your clothes will not withstand me.
If you mean to ride, be quick.

lines.zh: 我看着你，火苗低了下去。
lines.en: I look at you and the flame sinks.

lines.zh: 你身上有烧过木头的味道。
lines.en: You smell of burnt wood.
I lower myself so you can see my back.
Your lantern makes me shine.
I know you mean to ride me.
My flames sink lower.
I pull back and a few feathers fall.
I give one short cry.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的火低了一截。
lines.en: That dropped my fire a notch.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，火星洒了一地。
lines.en: I shudder and sparks spill.
I draw my wings in slowly.
The tips of my feathers are scorched.
I tilt my head and recover.
You scattered my fire.
I retreat behind the stone ledge.
That lamp in your hand burns well.
When the fire rises, I must come near.
Bring the lamp closer.
That pile of wood; I want to burn it.
There is smoke on your hands.
You move toward the fire; good.
I reach my beak toward that light.
Add another stick.
That lamp's flame suits me.
I walk over to your lamp.
You touch me and your sleeve scorches.
We collide and sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，火苗扫到你。
lines.en: I give half a step and a flame licks you.
Come close, and your hem will singe.
I put a wing between us.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一歪，火星落地。
lines.en: Knocked askew, sparks hit the ground.

lines.zh: 相撞后，你的护甲半天不凉。
lines.en: After the bump, your armour stays warm.
I push you out lest you catch fire.

lines.zh: 我们分开，中间还有热气。
lines.en: We part, and heat lingers between us.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾羽，我抽了一下。
lines.en: You step on my tail feathers and I jerk.
Heat brought me out of the egg.
That would take a long time.

lines.zh: 我身上的火不适合两个人。
lines.en: This fire on me is not fit for two.
I turn my head slowly aside.

lines.zh: 你太近了，再说就烧到你。
lines.en: You are too close; speak more and you burn.
In the firelight we build no nest.
I am the only one here.
There are no such words in fire.
I walk toward the doorway.

lines.zh: 我的蛋，在炼狱摇篮里焐过。
lines.en: My egg was warmed in an Inferno Cradle.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓起，它在冒烟。
lines.en: I take it in my claw and it smokes.

lines.zh: 我叼起来的时候烫了一下。
lines.en: It burns a little when I pick it up in my beak.
This will burn; good.
One claw pins it down.

lines.zh: 我拿起来，火就顺着上来。
lines.en: I lift it and fire climbs it.
This is too hot; I leave it.
I drop it on the stone.
I hold it up to the flame.
The edge of your thing has scorched.

lines.zh: 我拾起来，地上留了个印。
lines.en: I pick it up and leave a mark.
I look toward that lamp.

lines.zh: 你身上带的那点火，我熟。
lines.en: I know that little fire you carry.
I turn to you over the embers.
Chosen: this lamp.
I walk to you over the embers.
The fire has your position.
I want you to carry me out of here.
I lower my head, ready.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我的火够得着。
lines.en: At this range my fire reaches.
I turn my head toward the lamp.
I begin following that little fire.
No need to shout; I hear you.
I shift toward the doorway on your side.
I have claimed this lamp.
I keep walking toward your lamp.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的火也跟着动。
lines.en: You move, and my fire moves too.
I close in from your rear flank.
You look back and my fire is still there.
My heat keeps with you.
You retreat, and I am in no hurry.
Set the lamp down and I will be there.
I do not call; the fire speaks.
I wait for you to raise your hand.
The nearer you are to fire, the nearer I am.
I walk along your steps.

lines.zh: 你改道，我的火星也改道。
lines.en: You change course, and my sparks change with you.
Raise your hand, then.

lines.zh: 你退到石阶下，我等在那儿。
lines.en: You back to the stone steps; I wait there.
One wingbeat and the fire comes with it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓在你肩上，很烫。
lines.en: My claws rake your shoulder, and they are hot.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推得退了几步。
lines.en: That shoves you back several steps.
I peck your armour.
Your sleeve starts to smoke.
That blow carried the heat of fire.

lines.zh: 我打在你手背上，留了个印。
lines.en: I strike your hand and leave a mark.
I dive down with fire.
You are knocked against a pillar.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了火的一半。
lines.en: I used only half my fire in that.
A shape rises out of the flames.
The stone egg first turns red with heat.

lines.zh: 你先看到一点火星飘过来。
lines.en: You see a spark drifting over first.

lines.zh: 我从燎原的热里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the spreading heat.
The wood begins to burn on its own.
I step out from behind the fire.

lines.zh: 这一带的空气忽然烫了。
lines.en: The air here suddenly turns hot.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀一抖，火星满地。
lines.en: I shake my wings and sparks cover the floor.
I drop from the roof ridge.

lines.zh: 府邸的梁上，火烧起来了。
lines.en: The manor's beams catch fire first.

lines.zh: 我站定，脚下的石头裂了。
lines.en: I settle, and the stone under me cracks.
I spread my wings before you.

lines.zh: 火扑上来，我吞下去，更旺了。
lines.en: Fire engulfs me and I swallow it, burning brighter.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，翅没张开。
lines.en: I fall from a height before my wings open.
Water pours on me and I hiss out steam.
The blast blows my fire crooked.

lines.zh: 箭射进火里，一下就烧没了。
lines.en: The arrow enters my fire and burns away.

lines.zh: 法术压住火，我暗了一下。
lines.en: Magic presses on the flame and I dim.

lines.zh: 没有东西可烧，我渐渐弱了。
lines.en: Nothing left to burn, and I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的火猛地窜高。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my fire leaps high.

lines.zh: 虚空吸走热，我的火快灭了。
lines.en: The void draws the heat out and my fire nearly dies.
